- Purple 3x3s: one at (4–6, 30–32) in the HUD, one at (58–60, 3–5) at the bottom-left.
- Bottom row 63 is all white.
The dashed line runs from the ball's center (15,48) through (21,42)...(51,12), (55,8), (57,6) — passing right through the plus at (53,10)? Let me check: the line's points are (row, col): (21,42),(23,40),(25,38),(27,36),(29,34),(31,32),(33,30),(35,28),(37,26),(39,24),(41,22),(43,20),(45,18),(47,16),(49,14),(51,12),(55,8),(57,6). Let me try a MOUSE click at the plus center (53, 10). If the ball launches, I'll see an animation. If the aim just moves (the line rotates to point at the click position — but the click is already at the plus, so the line won't change), nothing will happen.

- If nothing changes → the MOUSE is aim-only, and I need to find the fire action.
